scope: Verbatim pre-existing threshold-count calculation branches only; no observed outputs, count, verdict, author summary or old reviewer conclusion copied. Original THRESHOLDS from evaluate.py, raw test summaries must be independently reconstructed. This extraction does not establish these derived subcriteria as a separately predeclared training plan.

variable_contract.constants[THRESHOLDS]: Original literal eight named thresholds in scripts/selftrained/evaluate.py
variable_contract.tasks: Independent reaggregation of original final test per-task records; semantic, format, exact rates and OCR final_cer
variable_contract.chain: Original generated tool-call rows independently regraded; tool_roundtrip numerator/denominator/rate
variable_contract.metrics: Original raw aggregate test metrics; the first extracted line constructs strata only for intent, query_class and query_position, with independent rates. ratio(n,d) denotes exact n/d with numerator and denominator retained.
